snippet.title: Watermellionaire | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In this dark battle royale fruit-matching game, you're pitted against other employees to compete for the title of Most Valuable Packer (MVP) - those who fail are fired. Faced with nothing but a box, some fruit and a guard watching your every move, only one person can come out on top.

Wishlist today: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4640180/Watermellionaire/
